title: Detention and Locker
author: Rosalind Whitlock
blurb: Ulyana Thornbury, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
